subject_line: Application for Software Engineer (Freshers) - Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am applying for the Software Engineer (Freshers) position. I have built backend services using Python, FastAPI, and RESTful APIs, and deployed applications on AWS with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. My experience includes developing an AI-powered resume builder and managing database models and migrations.

I have attached my resume for your review.
